title: Harness may grant the Android probe every runtime permission
context: Android setup A0 step 4: voice, video, photo pick and reminder journeys stall on runtime permission prompts unless someone taps Allow. The plan requires asking the owner once.
options: Harness grants camera, microphone, photos and notifications with adb shell pm grant
Owner taps Allow on each prompt on the phone
outcome: Owner, 2026-09-24: "Start the Android testing. You have permission to test everything including camera, microphone, notification, photos, etc." The harness grants the probe (and the plain app for A15) its runtime permissions and exercises camera, microphone, notifications and photos. Other ask-first items (sign-ins, exports leaving the device, destructive actions on real data, system settings, downloads) are unchanged.
